assessment: In this valuable study, Tutak and colleagues set out to identify factors that mediate Repeat Associated Non-AUG (RAN) translation of CGG repeats in the FMR1 mRNA which are implicated in toxic protein accumulation that underpins ensuing neurological pathologies. The authors provide solid evidence that RPS26 may be implicated in mediating the RAN translation of FMR1 mRNA. This article should be of broad interest to researchers in the variety of disciplines including post-transcriptional regulation of gene expression and neurobiology.
